_comment: Intended state of the hands-off update pipeline — the parts that live
OUTSIDE this repo (Renovate/Mend app install + settings, app repos).
scripts/check-update-pipeline.sh verifies reality against this record;
the update-pipeline-freshness workflow runs it weekly and raises an
issue on drift. FILL AT COMMISSIONING: list your app repos below, and
record here (as your runbook) the external steps you performed:
- Fleet GitHub App (create ONCE per operator with
scripts/fleet-app-setup.py; record id/slug/key location here):
installed on each org (one click:
github.com/apps/<slug>/installations/new, All repositories).
- Renovate: SELF-HOSTED runner repo (copy the reference:
uppertoe/renovate-runner — 4 files; keep it PRIVATE, its logs
enumerate private repo names). Secrets: FLEET_APP_ID,
FLEET_APP_PRIVATE_KEY, and for PRIVATE images GHCR_READ_TOKEN
(classic PAT, read:packages) referenced by the runner's config.js
hostRules — NOT by renovate.json5 (repo configs cannot hold
secrets). Fill renovate_runner_repo below.
- Private fleet repos are verified with per-owner tokens minted from
the fleet app by update-pipeline-freshness.yml (secrets
FLEET_APP_ID/FLEET_APP_PRIVATE_KEY on this repo; edit the owner
names in the workflow's mint steps). No stored PATs.
- Each app repo: publish workflow gated on tests AND a boot smoke
(build with load:true, docker run, curl /healthz, only then push),
plus a weekly schedule: cron so base-image fixes rebuild without a
code push (stagger the crons; GitHub disables schedules after ~60
days of repo inactivity — this weekly check catches that).
